target.statement: usfAD OCC model's average F1-score (or accuracy) on NSL-KDD under 10-run stratified 80/20 splits, trained on benign-only data with threshold μ−3σ
target.table_ref: Table (results section, per-dataset OCC comparison; NSL-KDD row)

compute.basis: NSL-KDD is small and public, but no code is released; the agent must reimplement usfAD (stochastic forest anomaly detector from Aryal 2018/2021), the μ−3σ thresholding, and the 10-run 80/20 protocol, plus install PyOD for baselines; all CPU-feasible in a few hours.

blockers: No code or configs released (empty link list)
